minutes.headline: Committee approved a year-end line-item transfer, new middle school ELA curriculum, four finance policies, and spending leftover ESSER funds on technology.
minutes.summary: The School Committee held its meeting with Mrs. Kelly's last meeting marked, a superintendent's award, and staff appreciation resolutions. It approved a small end-of-year transfer, the grades 6-8 ELA curriculum adoption (funded partly by grants), and four finance policies, and authorized leftover ESSER funds for technology. It then discussed the municipal building committee's concepts, including Turkey Hill, and went into executive session.

budget_items.topic: End of year line item transfer
budget_items.what_was_said: Business manager proposed a clean-up transfer among accounts, including middle school substitutes and high school sped long-term subs, to cover negative balances.
Smaller transfers cover a pallet jack, water charges, and printer lease/maintenance, offset by surpluses in heating and computer repair.

budget_items.topic: Middle school regular subs over budget
budget_items.what_was_said: A member asked about the line being far over budget; the business manager attributed it to long-term absences covered with short-term subs.
District awarded additional ECF funding for more Chromebooks to support its replacement cycle.
Program cost is covered by a scholarship in the first year, with a renewal cost later.
PTO book fair proceeds deposited in gift fund earmarked for Turkey Hill library.
figures_as_heard: two thousand one hundred three dollars and thirty five cents

budget_items.what_was_said: Grants cover part of first-year print and digital subscriptions and initial PD; a second grant covers materials; student consumables go into the building budget in the fall.
SR2 funds expire September 30th 2023; a small surplus is projected and administration asked flexibility to spend it on technology; SR3 on target.
Business manager said the district is on target and will not exceed the town-established budget amount; an added out-of-district student complicated planning.
Rough estimates for new TCP build, town hall, and Ritter building renovation/addition discussed for select board.

transfers.description: End-of-year transfers including 2500 to middle school regular substitute account and one thousand to high school sped long-term sub account, plus equipment, water, and maintenance accounts

decisions.decision: Administration will report back on any ESSER technology spending at end of August or beginning of September.
Line item transfers will be placed after the budget presentation on future agendas.
Committee asked for a follow-up (or detailed explanation) from the district on enabling PACE to broadcast hybrid meetings live from the Middle High School.
Bullying law legal overview: pursue scheduling a lawyer or a pre-recorded presentation soon.
Scoreboard advertisement cover-up added to future discussion list.

what_happened.line: The School Committee approved the new grades 6-8 English language arts curriculum; grants cover part of the first-year costs.
It approved four finance policies on a third read, with an Oxford comma corrected.
It authorized administration to spend any leftover ESSER (SR2) funds on technology as of June 30; administration will report back in late August or early September.
It approved an end-of-year line-item transfer to cover negative balances, including substitute lines, and accepted the quarterly budget report.
The committee heard rough estimates from the municipal building committee for a new Turkey Hill build, town hall and the Ritter building, then went into executive session.

why_it_matters: The curriculum adoption and the ESSER technology authorization touch what the schools buy next year, and the ESSER money expires September 30, 2023, so it cannot fund anything after that.
The building estimates for Turkey Hill, town hall and the Ritter building are early concepts for the select board. Any project would reach residents later as a spending vote.
watch_next: Administration's report on ESSER technology spending, due at the end of August or beginning of September.
Line-item transfers are to be placed after the budget presentation on future agendas.
